subtitle.en: 1206–1294 · one power at both ends of the map
subtitle.zh: 1206–1294 · 同时握住地图两端的唯一一次

summary.en: In ninety years a steppe confederation destroyed or subdued every major state from Korea to Hungary, killed perhaps a tenth of the people in its path, and then held the roads open: paper money, postal relays, Marco Polo, the plague. The largest land empire in history, and the only time the whole of this map has had one ruler.
summary.zh: 九十年里，一个草原联盟摧毁或征服了从朝鲜到匈牙利的每一个主要国家，杀死了沿途约十分之一的人口，然后把道路打通：纸币、驿站、马可·波罗、瘟疫。史上最大的陆地帝国，也是这张图唯一一次只有一个统治者。

source: The Secret History of the Mongols; Juvayni, History of the World Conqueror; Rashid al-Din; T. May, The Mongol Empire (2018)

text.en: A kurultai of the steppe tribes proclaims Temüjin 'Genghis Khan'. He reorganises the tribes into decimal units loyal to him alone, writes down the law, and adopts a script. The machine is built before the first invasion.
text.zh: 草原各部的忽里勒台推举铁木真为「成吉思汗」。他把部落改编成只效忠于他的十进制单位，写下法典，采用文字。机器在第一次入侵之前就造好了。

text.en: First campaign against a settled state: the Tangut kingdom submits and pays tribute. The Mongols learn siege warfare here and will return in 1227 to annihilate it.
text.zh: 对定居国家的第一次远征：党项人的王国屈服纳贡。蒙古人在这里学会攻城，并将在1227年回来把它彻底消灭。

text.en: The Jin capital (modern Beijing) falls after a year's siege; it burns for a month. Chinese engineers and officials enter Mongol service — among them Yelü Chucai, who persuades Ögedei that taxing peasants is better than killing them.
text.zh: 金中都（今北京）被围一年后陷落，大火烧了一个月。汉地工匠和官员进入蒙古人的队伍——其中有耶律楚材，他说服窝阔台：向农民征税比杀掉他们更好。

text.en: The Khwarazm-shah had executed Genghis's merchant envoys. Bukhara surrenders and is sacked anyway; in the great mosque Genghis tells the citizens he is the punishment of God. Samarkand falls next, then Merv, Nishapur, Herat — cities of hundreds of thousands, emptied.
text.zh: 花剌子模沙杀了成吉思汗的商队使节。布哈拉投降，仍被洗劫；成吉思汗在大清真寺里对市民说，他是神的惩罚。接着是撒马尔罕、木鹿、尼沙普尔、赫拉特——几十万人口的城市，被掏空。

stops.w: Mongol conquest of the Khwarazmian Empire

text.en: A reconnaissance in force by Jebe and Sübedei rides round the Caspian, defeats the Georgians, and crushes a Rus'–Cuman army. The princes are suffocated under the victory-feast platform. Then the Mongols simply ride home.
text.zh: 哲别和速不台的一支侦察大军绕过里海，击败格鲁吉亚人，再击溃罗斯-库曼联军。罗斯诸王公被压死在庆功宴的木台下。然后蒙古人径直骑马回家。

text.en: Ögedei builds a capital with a palace, a silver tree fountain by a Parisian goldsmith, and a street of mosques, churches and temples. From here the empire is run by post-horse: a rider can reach Kiev in weeks.
text.zh: 窝阔台建都，有宫殿、巴黎金匠造的银树喷泉、一条清真寺、教堂、佛寺并立的街。帝国从这里靠驿马运转：骑手几周可到基辅。

text.en: Batu's western campaign takes Ryazan, Vladimir, then Kiev, the mother of Rus' cities. A papal envoy six years later finds 'countless skulls and bones' and 200 houses standing. Rus' will pay the Golden Horde tribute for 240 years.
text.zh: 拔都的西征先取梁赞、弗拉基米尔，再取「罗斯诸城之母」基辅。六年后一位教宗使节看到「无数的头骨和骸骨」和两百间尚存的房屋。罗斯将向金帐汗国纳贡二百四十年。

text.en: Two days apart, two armies: Polish and German knights destroyed at Legnica, the Hungarian army at Mohi. Europe lies open. Then news arrives that Ögedei is dead, and Batu turns back to elect a new khan. Europe is spared by a funeral.
text.zh: 相隔两天的两场仗：波兰和德意志骑士在莱格尼察被歼，匈牙利军队在穆希被歼。欧洲门户洞开。然后传来窝阔台去世的消息，拔都回师参加大汗推选。欧洲因一场葬礼得救。

text.en: Hulagu takes the Abbasid capital in twelve days. The caliph is rolled in a carpet and trampled; the House of Wisdom's books are thrown into the Tigris until, the chroniclers say, it ran black. Five hundred years of Abbasid rule end; the city will not matter again for seven centuries.
text.zh: 旭烈兀十二天攻陷阿拔斯都城。哈里发被卷在地毯里踏死；智慧宫的藏书被扔进底格里斯河，编年史说河水变黑。阿拔斯五百年统治终结；这座城七个世纪内不再重要。

text.en: The Mamluks of Egypt — slave-soldiers, many of them Kipchak Turks bought from the Mongols' own markets — defeat a Mongol army in Galilee. The first decisive defeat, and the limit of the empire in the west.
text.zh: 埃及的马穆鲁克——奴隶士兵，很多是从蒙古人自己的市场上买来的钦察突厥人——在加利利击败一支蒙古军。第一次决定性的失败，也是帝国在西方的极限。

text.en: Kublai proclaims the Yuan dynasty and builds a new capital on the ruins of Zhongdu — the plan of today's Beijing. Marco Polo arrives in 1275 and stays seventeen years. The empire has split into four khanates; Kublai is Great Khan in name.
text.zh: 忽必烈建元，在中都废墟上建新都——今天北京的格局。马可·波罗1275年到达，待了十七年。帝国已分为四大汗国；忽必烈只是名义上的大汗。

text.en: The last Song fleet is destroyed off the Guangdong coast; the chancellor jumps into the sea with the child emperor on his back. All of China is under one foreign ruler for the first time.
text.zh: 南宋最后的舰队在广东海岸覆灭；丞相背着幼帝跳海。中国第一次全部处于一个异族统治者之下。

text.en: Kublai's second invasion of Japan, 140,000 men, is wrecked by a typhoon after seven weeks of fighting. The Japanese call it kamikaze, the divine wind. The empire has found its eastern limit too.
text.zh: 忽必烈第二次征日，十四万人，激战七周后被台风摧毁。日本人称之为神风。帝国也找到了它东方的极限。

text.en: Kublai dies. His paper currency, his Grand Canal, his observatory and the Persian astronomers in it outlive him; so does the plague bacillus moving west along his post-roads. In fifty years it will reach Caffa, and Europe.
text.zh: 忽必烈去世。他的纸币、大运河、天文台和台里的波斯天文学家都比他活得久；沿着他的驿路西行的鼠疫杆菌也是。五十年后它将抵达卡法，然后是欧洲。
